mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HM_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND MEMBER_ROLE IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN') AND MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' )

SELECT C.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, C.DESCRIPTION AS description, C.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder, C.USE_YN AS useYn, COALESCE(CLUB_COUNTS.CLUB_COUNT, 0) AS clubCount, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, C.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM HM_CATEGORY C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CATEGORY_ID, COUNT(*) AS CLUB_COUNT FROM HM_CLUB GROUP BY CATEGORY_ID ) CLUB_COUNTS ON CLUB_COUNTS.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID
C.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID IS NULL
AND C.CATEGORY_NAME LIKE #{keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND C.USE_YN = #{useYn}
ORDER BY C.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, C.CATEGORY_ID ASC
mapper.sql: SELECT C.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, C.DESCRIPTION AS description, C.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder, C.USE_YN AS useYn, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HM_CLUB CLUB WHERE CLUB.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID ) AS clubCount, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, C.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM HM_CATEGORY C WHERE C.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND C.PARENT_CATEGORY_ID IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(DISPLAY_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM HM_CATEGORY WHERE PARENT_CATEGORY_ID IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HM_CATEGORY ( PARENT_CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME, DESCRIPTION, DISPLAY_ORDER, USE_YN, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( NULL, #{categoryName}, #{description}, #{displayOrder}, #{useYn}, #{adminMemberId}, #{adminMemberId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE HM_CATEGORY SET CATEGORY_NAME = #{command.categoryName}, DESCRIPTION = #{command.description}, DISPLAY_ORDER = #{command.displayOrder}, USE_YN = #{command.useYn}, UPDATED_BY = #{command.adminMemberId}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND PARENT_CATEGORY_ID IS NULL
UPDATE HM_CATEGORY SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDATED_BY = #{adminMemberId}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND PARENT_CATEGORY_ID IS NULL AND USE_YN <> #{useYn}
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID FROM HM_CATEGORY WHERE PARENT_CATEGORY_ID IS NULL ORDER BY CATEGORY_ID FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE HM_CATEGORY SET DISPLAY_ORDER = #{displayOrder}, UPDATED_BY = #{adminMemberId}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} AND PARENT_CATEGORY_ID IS NULL
